# Apache ECharts

The complete browser distribution of **Apache ECharts 6.1.0** is bundled locally for `EECharts`. Charts work without a CDN or internet connection.

- Upstream release: [Apache ECharts 6.1.0](https://github.com/apache/echarts/releases/tag/6.1.0)
- Source: [echarts.min.js](https://github.com/apache/echarts/blob/6.1.0/dist/echarts.min.js)
- License: Apache-2.0. Upstream `LICENSE`, `NOTICE`, and the distribution's license header are preserved.
- SHA-256: `b66b25aeb4df84e33199dc21694014d336d222cbd9deb0e5a7c14bd6aa0d0fd0`

The upstream JavaScript keeps its distribution formatting. The Qt host and bridge are maintained separately.
